description: A real classic-Mac client answering a live psistorm challenge: retail Mac Diablo v1.09 (patched from the live server) run in a Mac OS 9 virtual machine, connected to useast.battle.net, 2026-10-06. Packets decoded from a pcap of the VM.
result: psistorm_template.c built with psistorm_build_04.h over these three data forks reproduces exe_version, checksum and exe_info exactly.
notes: The files are the installed Mac Diablo 1.09 files in "Diablo Folder/Diablo Files" on the VM disk (data forks only). Blizzard binaries are not stored in this repository; the SHA-256s identify them.

Server side (2026-10-06): DRTL on PMAC checks the hash. Correct answers from c/psistorm.c passed for builds 00, 04, 12, 14, 16, 18; corrupted checksums got 0x100; the exe-version dword is not validated.
